example: Add a bit of salt to the soup.
exampleTranslation: 在汤里加一点盐。

example: I will be back in a couple of minutes.
exampleTranslation: 我几分钟后就回来。

example: A few students stayed to clean the classroom.
exampleTranslation: 几个学生留下来打扫教室。

example: A dolphin is a kind of animal.
exampleTranslation: 海豚是一种动物。

example: I am a little bit nervous before the test.
exampleTranslation: 考试前我有一点紧张。

example: There are a lot of stars in the sky tonight.
exampleTranslation: 今晚天空中有很多星星。

example: He received a set of tools for his birthday.
exampleTranslation: 他生日时收到了一套工具。

example: The shop assistant showed us the right size.
exampleTranslation: 店员给我们拿了合适的尺码。

example: Practice can improve your ability to speak English.
exampleTranslation: 练习能提高你的英语口语能力。

example: We talked about our plans for the weekend.
exampleTranslation: 我们谈论了周末计划。

example: Her uncle works abroad for a year.
exampleTranslation: 她叔叔在国外工作一年。

example: Lily was absent from school because she was ill.
exampleTranslation: 莉莉因为生病没来上学。

example: Call an adult if you see an accident.
exampleTranslation: 如果你看到事故，请叫一位成年人。

example: According to the notice, the library closes at six.
exampleTranslation: 根据通知，图书馆六点关门。

example: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
exampleTranslation: 她努力实现自己的目标。

example: Winning the prize was a great achievement for him.
exampleTranslation: 赢得这个奖对他来说是一项了不起的成就。

example: We walked across the bridge after lunch.
exampleTranslation: 午饭后我们走过了那座桥。

example: The children will act in the school play.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们将出演学校的戏剧。

example: The teacher praised him for his quick action.
exampleTranslation: 老师表扬了他迅速的行动。

example: My grandfather is still active at eighty.
exampleTranslation: 我祖父八十岁时仍然很活跃。

example: The club has a different activity every Friday.
exampleTranslation: 社团每周五都有不同的活动。

example: Actually, the answer is easier than it looks.
exampleTranslation: 实际上，这个答案比看起来简单。

example: Please write your home address on the form.
exampleTranslation: 请在表格上写下你的家庭住址。

example: We admire her courage and kindness.
exampleTranslation: 我们敬佩她的勇气和善良。

example: One advantage of cycling is that it is good exercise.
exampleTranslation: 骑自行车的一个优点是它能锻炼身体。

example: My teacher gave me useful advice about reading.
exampleTranslation: 老师给了我关于阅读的有用建议。

example: I advise you to check your work carefully.
exampleTranslation: 我建议你认真检查作业。

example: We cannot afford a new computer this year.
exampleTranslation: 我们今年买不起一台新电脑。

example: He read the poem again and again.
exampleTranslation: 他一遍又一遍地读这首诗。

example: The bike is leaning against the wall.
exampleTranslation: 自行车靠在墙上。

example: The travel agent helped us book the tickets.
exampleTranslation: 旅行社代理人帮我们订了票。

example: We all agree that the plan is safe.
exampleTranslation: 我们都同意这个计划是安全的。

example: I agree with your idea about the trip.
exampleTranslation: 我同意你关于这次旅行的想法。

example: The two teams reached an agreement.
exampleTranslation: 两支队伍达成了一致。

example: The road ahead is closed because of snow.
exampleTranslation: 前方道路因下雪关闭了。

example: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
exampleTranslation: 我们提前两小时到达机场。

example: The twins look alike, but they like different sports.
exampleTranslation: 这对双胞胎看起来很像，但喜欢不同的运动。

example: The fish was still alive when we found it.
exampleTranslation: 我们发现那条鱼时，它还活着。

example: All the lights were off when we left.
exampleTranslation: 我们离开时所有灯都关了。

example: The child learned to dress all by himself.
exampleTranslation: 这个孩子学会了自己穿衣服。
